summary_en: CEL Corporation executed a block acquisition of 10,000 shares at 4,395 yen per share on November 24, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, totaling 43.95 million yen or 0.3% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, to secure shares for employee stock plans and support flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 20, 2026, CEL Corporation's board of directors resolved to execute a block acquisition of treasury stock. The company purchased 10,000 shares of its own common stock at a fixed price of 4,395 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on November 24, 2026. The total acquisition amount was 43.95 million yen, representing 0.3% of issued shares excluding treasury stock (3,436,818 shares as of October 31, 2026).

The acquisition was conducted as a single transaction via ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of that date. The buy order was limited to the trading session on November 24, 2026, and execution was contingent on matching sell orders. The company stated it may partially or fully forgo the acquisition depending on market conditions.

The stated purpose is to stably procure shares for employee stock plans (BBT and J-ESOP) and to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business circumstances. This acquisition represents execution of the board's standing authorization under Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation.
